title: Latent Inference — sections configuration
description: Single source of truth for the site's sections (kept under the historical `courses` key). Add or edit an entry to add or rename a section. `group` puts a section in that nav pull-down; a section without a group gets its own top-level nav link. Source PDFs live in Documents/<dir>/ (`npm run extract`).

slug.description: URL-safe identifier used in /sections/<slug> and validated server-side.

shortTitle.description: Compact title for nav and cards.

dir.description: Source folder name under `Documents/` holding this section's PDFs.

group.description: Nav group id from `groups`. Omit for a top-level nav link.

navShort.description: Top-level nav label on narrow screens (ungrouped sections only).

tagline.description: One-line description shown in the nav menu.

blurb.description: One-line standfirst shown on the section front.
